invariants.rationale: The method populates fields on 'result' so it must not be null.
'result.setWriteStatuses(statuses)' is always called, so after the method, getWriteStatuses() cannot be null.
The code always calls 'result.setIndexUpdateDuration', guaranteeing the value is not null before returning.
The method always sets partitionToReplaceFileIds in result using getPartitionToReplacedFileIds.
The field set via 'setWriteStatuses' receives a List (from collectAsList()); so its value must be a List.
